Is your quarter silver?
Silver years:
1932–1964 (plus 1976 Bicentennial 40% silver proof/collector issues).
A 1964-or-earlier quarter is 90% silver. The quickest tell is the edge: silver quarters show a solid silver-white edge, while modern clad quarters show a copper-colored stripe.

Which quarters are worth money
Silver quarters (1932–1964): worth their melt value in silver, often several dollars each.
Key dates: 1932-D and 1932-S Washington quarters are the series keys.
Errors: 1950-D/S over-mintmark, doubled-die varieties, and off-center/clipped planchet errors carry premiums.
Standing Liberty (1916–1930) and Barber (1892–1916) quarters are older 90% silver types with strong collector demand.
